description: Read a host's TLS certificate: issuer, validity dates and days remaining, subject alternative names, key type and size, signature algorithm, chain, negotiated protocol and whether the chain is trusted and covers the hostname. Use it on an MTA-STS policy host (mta-sts.<domain>) or a click-tracking domain, where an expired certificate stops mail or turns every click into a browser warning. Port 25 is not reachable from serverless, so the certificate an MX host presents cannot be read this way.

domain.description: Hostname to read a certificate from, e.g. "mta-sts.acme.com". A URL or host:port is accepted.

port.description: TCP port. Defaults to 443. Port 25 is rejected: outbound SMTP is blocked.

name: check_ssl
title: TLS certificate
